personality_one_liner: A sleek, command-center aesthetic for fast slot booking, using deep carbon tones and amber accents to evoke the warm glow of clean headlights.

spacing.rule: Generous intentional padding. Content must never touch screen edges. Sticky primary buttons must float cleanly above the safe area with a translucent backdrop.

do's: Use strict solid surface separation (surfaceSecondary, dividers) rather than blur, matching the Dark-First Utility command-center feel.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur or glass effects. The app should feel tactile, fast, and mechanical.

screens.name: Available Slots (Home)
screens.purpose: Allow users to instantly see open headlight cleaning slots and tap to book.

states.empty: Abstract amber light background with 'No available slots right now' text and a check back later CTA.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top (car headlight) covered by a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. Below it, a segmented control or date picker, followed by a grid of available time slots (surfaceSecondary cards with brandTertiary active states).

screens.name: Booking Form
screens.purpose: Capture name, phone, car make/model, and notes to reserve the selected slot.

states.loading: Submitting spinner inside the sticky CTA.
states.error: Inline field errors with red borders/text.

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form. Labels above inputs. Car brand/model use a bottom sheet selector. The 'Confirm Booking' button MUST be sticky at the bottom of the screen above the home indicator, outside the scrollview.

screens.name: My Bookings
screens.purpose: Users can view the status of their booked appointments without logging in (stored locally or via phone lookup).

states.empty: Illustration/icon of an empty calendar, 'You have no recent bookings.'
states.error: Failed to load bookings, retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical list of cards. Each card displays date, time, car details, and a high-contrast status badge (Amber/Warning for pending, Green/Success for confirmed, Red/Error for rejected). Cards use 100% width minus layout margins.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for the owner to manage slots and confirm/reject pending bookings.

states.empty: No pending bookings or upcoming slots.
states.error: Failed to sync, manual refresh CTA.

screens.layout: Requires a password overlay on first entry. Uses a top-tab or segmented control to switch between 'Manage Slots' (create new available times) and 'Requests' (approve/reject). Tactical, data-dense list rows for easy scanning.

home_hero.alt: A close up of a glowing car headlight in the dark

admin_header.alt: Parked black sports car in dark environment

empty_state.alt: Abstract amber light shapes against a dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Identity: STRICTLY stick to the Dark-First Utility aesthetic. Use obsidian/carbon bases with deep amber accents (brand: #FF9800) to evoke automotive headlight glow. ALL BLUES ARE BANNED.
Form Layout: The primary 'Confirm Booking' button MUST be anchored sticky at the bottom of the screen using KeyboardAvoidingView. Content flows behind it.

Hero Images: When placing text over the 'home_hero' or 'admin_header' images, you MUST use a vertical 3-stop expo-linear-gradient scrim going from transparent to #0D0D0D (surface) at 80%+ opacity at the bottom. Never render raw text directly on photos.
Card Layout: List items and booking cards must span 100% of the horizontal space (minus the container's lateral padding). Avoid half-width left-clustered cards.
Interactions: Make slot selection and status changes fast and tactile. Connect the haptics block strictly to button presses and state changes.
Typography: Use Barlow Condensed for numerical data, metrics, timeslots, and main headers. Use Satoshi for body text and input values.

Admin Access: Build a simple inline password wall (e.g. standard TextInput on the Admin tab) before revealing the Admin Dashboard UI. No complex auth/backend required, just local state or basic validation.
